# NickLinney.env - Assessment Charter

## Metadata

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Parent Event | ECI-NEE-2026-07-28-01 |
| Module | NickLinney.env |
| Assessment Date | July 28, 2026 |
| Assessment Type | Internal enterprise capability investigation |
| Assessment Scope | Module-level SICAF and RCMF evaluation |
| Assessment Lead | NickLinney.Ops Governance Lead |
| Sponsor | Enterprise Capability Investigation Executive Sponsor |

## Objective

Assess NickLinney.env using the ECEGF lifecycle to determine the current strength of strategic design intent, the observable maturity of runtime operation, and the priority gaps that should be tracked as enterprise improvement work.

## Capability Summary

Standardized development environment bootstrap and workstation provisioning capability.

## Business Context

Developer environment consistency layer that improves reproducibility and onboarding.

## Assessment Boundary

The assessment considers currently observable artifacts from the local project corpus, adjacent module references where relevant, and explicit evidence absence where no stronger proof is available.

## Evidence Position

Direct project and change-history evidence. This assessment is intentionally conservative and does not treat conceptual ambition as proof of operational maturity.
